metadata.title: COMPONENT: GROUND PLEX — ON-PREMISES DATA PLANE
metadata.author: SnapLogic Solutions Engineering

content.title: COMPONENT: GROUND PLEX — ON-PREMISES DATA PLANE
content.content:
The Ground Plex is SnapLogic's on-premises execution engine. It is the heart of the deployment for Airbus Helicopters — the component that makes SnapLogic genuinely on-premises rather than cloud-first. Every pipeline execution, every data transformation, and every connector call happens inside the Ground Plex, inside AH's private data center. The Ground Plex communicates with the SnapLogic Manager exclusively over a single outbound HTTPS connection (port 443). No inbound firewall rules. No data egress.

- Deployed as Docker containers on RedHat OpenShift, managed via SnapLogic-certified Helm charts

- Each Ground Plex node runs multiple JCC (Java Cloud Connector) containers — each capable of 100+ concurrent pipeline executions

- Active-active multi-node configuration for HA — node failure causes automatic redistribution

- Stateless by design — pipeline definitions and configuration are stored in the Manager, not on the node. New nodes are operational within minutes of deployment

- All connector credentials encrypted and stored locally within the Ground Plex; never transmitted to SnapLogic cloud

- Fully streaming execution architecture — Snaps process data as a stream rather than loading full datasets into memory, enabling high-throughput with predictable resource usage
